instruction: Please add folders "/home/user/data1" and "/home/user/data2" to the workspace, keeping the existing folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding two new folders while keeping the existing 'project' folder. The evaluator checks that all three folders are present in the workspace. Uses existing check_json_settings metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts workspace configuration file from VM using vm_file type
Metric function check_json_settings correctly handles expected parameter from get_rule - receives {'expected': {'folders': [...]}} and extracts the nested 'expected' dict to compare
Expected value semantically correct - checks for all 3 folders (existing 'project' + new 'data1' and 'data2') which matches instruction requirement
Coverage is complete - instruction requires adding 2 folders while keeping 1 existing folder, evaluator verifies all 3 folders are present
